description: When did this domain appear in the registry zone file, leave it, come back, or change nameservers? From the daily gTLD + .com/.net zone files we capture (daily since 2026-08-05; monthly 2013-2018). A sudden nameserver move is a hijack or sale signal; a brand-new name is a phishing signal. Price $0.010 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data: in_zone_now, first_seen, first_seen_is_coverage_start, last_seen, current_ns, events[{type: appeared|disappeared|reappeared|ns_changed, dates, from, to, message}], changed_last_30_days, coverage{daily_since, first_zone_file, runs}, ns_runs, note.
